resource: Value lines in one DUR-03 NPC BUY trade transaction (the bank part of the price)
allocation_impact: Checked in the payload gate and before any write; never truncated. 1 when the carried coins are worth less than the BUY price and the rest is debited from the buyer's (Account, World) bank balance (one FEE_DEBIT value line, class BURN, OneItemNpcTradeV1 field 14 bank_debit, an OneItemFeeBankDebitV1); then every coin BURN is whole, there is no change MINT and burned + bank_debit = total. 0 for a coin-only BUY and for every SELL. Admitted only under the (2, DUR03_ONE_ITEM_DURABLE_AUDIT_RETENTION_V2) tuple.
boundary_tests: max=1: a BUY with a bank part carries exactly one value line and is accepted
0: a coin-only BUY and every SELL carry none
max+1=2 rejected (INVALID_INPUT); a SELL carrying the value line is rejected (INVALID_INPUT)
a (1, V1) event carrying the value line is rejected (INVALID_INPUT)
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/npc_trade.rs (in-transaction BUY with its bank part; the one FEE_DEBIT bank entry is written in the same transaction)
notes: BANK-FEE-0 §4.3 and §5 (NPC BUY) with NPC-0 §5.3; NPC trade shape only: the DUR03-RL-01/02/06/07-NPC-TRADE-BUY rows are unchanged (the bank line adds one participant and 2 work units; the largest bank-part BUY of 20 whole burns, the bank line and the item MINT is 22 participants / 64 work units and fits the measured RL-07 byte rows).
